hints.title: Running Prefix Accumulation
hints.text: Traverse the array from left to right while keeping track of the current running sum.

hints.title: Negative Candidate Postponement
hints.text: Whenever running sum drops below 0, identify the most negative element seen so far and move it to the end.

hints.title: Sum Restoration
hints.text: Subtract that most negative number from the running sum (effectively undoing its subtraction) and increment operations.

hints.title: Greedy Min-Heap Deficit Recovery Implementation

complexity.notes: Heap pushes and pops take logarithmic time per negative element.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying combinations of which elements to postpone takes exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) priority queue storage for negative elements.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Greedily removes the most negative element whenever running prefix sum dips below 0.
